dialogOption.texten: 911, what's your emergency?
We need help. Some cables are hanging down on the field near the school, some kids are lying under the cables... I'll go get them out of there...
{BE CAREFUL} Ok, be careful sir and don't touch the cables.
Wait... the ground under the benches slided and there's some water flowing out, I guess some pipe has bursted.
{HELP THEM} They need your help!
Ok, ok I'm not deaf. There's a girl lying on... AAAAAAAAAH!
{WHERE ARE YOU?} First tell me where you are?
{SECURE THE AREA} First, secure the area.
What do you mean?
{ALERT OTHERS} Just stand somewhere near and warn other people not to go there. Ok?
But I want to help!
{WHAT DO YOU SEE?} Let's start with you figuring out what exactly is going on.
{EXAMINE THE CABLES} Please take a look at the cables, are they hanging above the ground, touching it, are thick or thin?
They aren't very thick and the wind is swinging them. Oh damn!
{WHAT HAPPENED?} What happened?
They sparkle when they touch the ground. A bit like fireworks.
{DON'T TOUCH THEM} Those cables are live, please don't approach them. I'll send firefighters, to come and take care of it.
So what am I supposed to do?
{THAT'S ENOUGH}There's nothing more you can do right now.
So I just have to wait?
{LOOK AROUND} I want you to look around, is there anything else going on besides the cables hanging down?
Wait... the ground under the benches slid and there's some water flowing out, I guess some pipe has bursted.
{IS WATER SPREADING?}Is the water spreading out on the field?
Yes, I can see that now, it flows slowly, but it's spreading.
{ARE VICTIMS IN THE WATER?}Are the victims lying in the water?
Yes. Should I get them away from there?
{JUST WAIT} Approaching them would be too dangerous, you have to wait.
Ok, I don't want to get hurt.
{TRY TO HELP THEM} If you're sure that you're able to help them please try. But remember your safety first sir.
OK, I will call you later!
{ADDRESS?} Which field is it?
The one at [[ADDRESS]].
its the Sue Bierman Park
its the Jefferson Square Park
its the Marina Green
Hey! I want to help them somehow.

reportElement.texten: Due to wrong operator instructions the caller was electrocuted. This resulted in casualty
Caller secured the area while waiting for emergency services.
